summary: A user's picture, in three sizes and three shapes, falling back to their initials and then to an icon, with an optional presence dot and badge.

props.name: src
props.description: The image. Leave it out, or let it fail, and the fallback takes over.

props.name: name
props.description: Alt text for the image, and the source of the initials when there is no image. Without it the fallback is a generic person icon.

props.name: fallback
props.description: What shows when there is no image, in place of the initials. Leave it empty for the initials, or for the person icon when there is no `name` either.

props.name: status
props.description: A presence dot in the bottom right corner. It carries meaning, so it is labelled for screen readers rather than left decorative.

props.name: badge
props.description: A badge in the top right corner. `status` takes the bottom right, so the two never collide and both can be on at once.

props.name: badgeIcon
props.description: The badge's icon, in place of the verified check. Give it `w:100% h:100%` to fill the badge.

props.name: size
props.description: Diameter, and the size of the initials or icon inside it.

props.name: shape
props.description: Corner radius. `squircle` uses `corner-shape`, which degrades to a rounded square where that is unsupported.
